provisions.original_text: Excerpt (abridged): Central Government may issue directions including directions for the closure, prohibition or regulation of any industry, operation or process, or stoppage/regulation of electricity, water or other services. Full statutory text: see India Code source link.
provisions.explanation: Regulator can direct closure or stop utilities for environmental non-compliance.
provisions.applicability: Any project causing / risking environmental pollution

provisions.original_text: Penalty provision as amended (including by Jan Vishwas (Amendment) Act, 2023 decriminalisation amendments). Do not rely on pre-amendment imprisonment text; read current text at India Code source link before acting.
provisions.explanation: Contraventions attract penalties under the current amended text; exact amount must be read from the current official text.
provisions.applicability: Contravention of EPA provisions, rules or directions
provisions.authority: Adjudicating officer / courts as per current text

provisions.original_text: Excerpt (abridged): No person shall, without previous consent of the State Board, establish an industry/operation likely to discharge sewage or trade effluent, or bring into use a new outlet/discharge. Full text: India Code.
provisions.explanation: Consent to Establish / Consent to Operate from Punjab PPCB (PPCB) needed before discharge-generating activity.
provisions.authority: State Pollution Control Board (PPCB in Punjab)

provisions.original_text: Excerpt (abridged): No person shall, without previous consent of the State Board, establish or operate an industrial plant in an air pollution control area. Full text: India Code.
provisions.explanation: DG sets, boilers and other emission sources typically trigger PPCB consent.
provisions.applicability: Air emissions in notified air pollution control areas
provisions.authority: State Pollution Control Board (PPCB in Punjab)

provisions.original_text: Notification (abridged): listed projects require prior environmental clearance; Item 8 covers Building/Construction (>=20,000 sq.m built-up) and Area Development/Townships (>=50 ha / >=150,000 sq.m). Thresholds and categories must be checked against the current amended Schedule at source.
provisions.explanation: A large data-centre campus may need prior EC depending on built-up area / area development thresholds.
provisions.applicability: Built-up area >=20,000 m2 or area development thresholds (verify current Schedule)

provisions.original_text: Rules (abridged): specified activities are prohibited within notified wetlands, including setting up/expansion of industries and disposal of waste/effluents. Full text: Gazette / MoEFCC.
provisions.explanation: Development in/near a notified wetland may be prohibited or regulated.
provisions.applicability: Site intersects or is near a notified wetland

provisions.original_text: Excerpt (abridged): Prior approval of Central Government is required for use of forest land for non-forest purposes / de-reservation, subject to current exemptions after 2023 amendment. Full current text: India Code.
provisions.explanation: If footprint uses recorded forest land, prior central approval is generally required.

provisions.section: Guidelines paras on NOC for groundwater extraction
provisions.original_text: Guidelines (abridged): industries and other abstractors require a No Objection Certificate for groundwater abstraction, with conditions, metering and charges varying by assessment-unit categorisation. Current text/charges: CGWA NOC portal.
provisions.explanation: Borewell-based cooling/process water generally needs CGWA (or applicable State) NOC.
provisions.applicability: Groundwater extraction above de-minimis / non-exempt use

provisions.original_text: Excerpt (abridged): NGT has jurisdiction over civil cases raising substantial environmental questions under Schedule I enactments, and may order relief/compensation and restitution. Full text: India Code.
provisions.explanation: Environmental disputes can be litigated before NGT; this is litigation forum, not an automatic penalty.

requirements.trigger_description: Built-up area at/above EIA Schedule Item 8 thresholds
requirements.consequence: Operating without required EC can lead to directions, closure and penalty/compensation proceedings under EPA framework - see current official text.

requirements.trigger_description: Generation/discharge of sewage or trade effluent
requirements.approval: Consent to Establish & Consent to Operate
requirements.consequence: Establishment/operation without consent can lead to directions including closure under Water Act / EPA powers.

requirements.trigger_description: Industrial plant / DG sets in air pollution control area
requirements.approval: Consent to Establish & Consent to Operate (Air)
requirements.consequence: Operation without consent can lead to directions including closure.

requirements.consequence_type: Regulatory enforcement / environmental compensation (per current guidelines)
requirements.consequence: Extraction without NOC may attract directions and environmental compensation as per current CGWA guidelines - verify amounts at source, not estimated here.

requirements.trigger_description: Notified wetland within site / proximity buffer
requirements.approval: Wetland authority review; prohibited activities cannot be approved in notified wetland
requirements.consequence: Prohibited activities in notified wetlands expose project to EPA directions and NGT proceedings.

requirements.trigger_description: Recorded forest land in footprint or immediate proximity requiring diversion check
requirements.approval: Forest Clearance (prior Central Govt approval) if forest land diverted
requirements.consequence: Use of forest land for non-forest purpose without approval can lead to stoppage and proceedings.

requirements.trigger_description: Any activity with pollution / environmental risk
requirements.approval: Comply with EPA rules, standards and directions
requirements.consequence: Section 5 directions may include closure or stoppage of utilities.
Affected persons/authorities may approach NGT seeking relief, compensation or restitution; outcome is case-specific.

amendments.status: Verify commencement/current text at India Code
